nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated by acceptOwnership.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set in the IPTVcontract constructor.
Public token name string, set in the IPTVcontract constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 18 in the IPTVcontract constructor.
Total token supply state variable, minted to the hard-coded owner address in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance; written by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; written by approve and approveAndCall, consumed by transferFrom and allowance.
SafeMath addition with overflow check require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division with division-by-zero check require(b > 0).
Owned constructor; assigns msg.sender to owner.
Sets newOwner; protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
Transfers ownership to newOwner after requiring msg.sender == newOwner.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
InterCryptoObject constructor; initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints balances to a hard-coded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to to using safeSub and safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without zeroing the previous allowance.
Moves tokens from from to to and decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then invokes spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data), executing arbitrary external code.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts.
Only-owner function calling transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with attacker-controlled spender and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the Owned constructor, so the deployer becomes the privileged account.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transfer uses msg.sender to read and write its own balance entry.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], letting the caller delegate its own allowance.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], spending the caller's allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into external code.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping returned by balanceOf.
to is the destination of the transfer.
tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
from is the source account of transferFrom.
to is the destination account of transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender becomes the callee address of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens is written to allowed and passed to the callback.
data is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
tokenAddress selects the external contract to call.
tokens is the amount requested from the external token contract.
Operand a participates in the checked addition inside safeAdd.
Operand b participates in the checked addition inside safeAdd.
Operand a participates in the checked subtraction inside safeSub.
Operand b participates in the checked subtraction inside safeSub.
Operand a participates in the checked multiplication inside safeMul.
Operand b participates in the checked multiplication inside safeMul.
Operand a participates in the checked division inside safeDiv.
Operand b is the divisor checked against zero inside safeDiv.
Local c holds a + b and is verified with require(c >= a).
Local c holds a - b after the require(b <= a) guard.
Local c holds a * b and is verified with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Local c holds a / b after the require(b > 0) guard.
Owned constructor sets owner from msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the requested new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor assigns the symbol string.
Constructor assigns the name string.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a hard-coded address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] via safeSub and safeAdd.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom adjusts balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking it is sufficient before the safeSub.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
approveAndCall invokes the caller-supplied contract's receiveApproval, handing control to untrusted code while the allowance is already updated.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract, which may execute arbitrary code.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists to feed the safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeSub arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeSub arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeMul arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeMul arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeDiv arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeDiv arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
_newOwner is the sole input of transferOwnership and is immediately stored in state.
tokenOwner is only used as a lookup key inside balanceOf.
to is a local input of transfer used only for the balances update and event.
tokens is a local input of transfer used only for the balances update and event.
spender is only used to index the allowed mapping inside approve.
tokens is only used as the allowance value inside approve.
from is only used to locate the balances entry to debit in transferFrom.
to is only used to locate the balances entry to credit in transferFrom.
tokens is the moved amount in transferFrom and has no independent meaning.
tokenOwner is only an index into the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is only an index into the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is used as the allowance key and as the callee of the external callback inside approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance amount forwarded to the external callback.
data is only forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress is only the target of the external transfer call.
tokens is only the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
Local c is the checked result of safeAdd and has no independent semantics.
Local c is the checked result of safeSub and has no independent semantics.
Local c is the checked result of safeMul and has no independent semantics.
Local c is the checked result of safeDiv and has no independent semantics.
